candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E dey cough and dey breath hard. E no dey vomit everything. E never convulse and e no dey convulse now. E no dey weak or dey sleep anyhow. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no get diarrhoea, e no get ear wahala, and e no get fever. I count breaths for one minute, na 45. Pikin calm when I dey count. I give am bronchodilator, finish the trial. After that, I count breaths for one minute, na 42. Pikin still calm after bronchodilator. No chest dey draw inside before or after bronchodilator. E no dey wheeze again and e no dey wheeze before. E no get stridor when calm. No recurrent wheeze. Pulse oximeter no dey available.
